player_prompt.intro:
Ami {role} Colonel Blotto-te.
Tumar lakshya tumar birodhi lak-te sairise jite thaka.
Pratyek round-e, {num_total_units} unit-ke {field_names} khetre barabe bantana.
Je khetre jae player besi unit bantae se khetre jite thae, ar je player besi khetre jite thae se round-tae jite thae.
Udaharan, '[A7 B7 C6]' 7 unit-ke A-te, 7-ke B-te, ar 6-ke C-te bantae thae.
